recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group still wants a full history Bundle example on the Bundle examples page, handle that as a separate confirmed editorial/example request rather than inferring it from the modified FHIR-23013 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-23013 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked for history interaction snippets to comply with the Bundle response requirements by adding required Bundle.entry.response.status values and for the guidance to state that, in addition to required response.status, servers should populate response.lastModified so the time of processing is clear in the history record.
initial_application: The issue was applied in 0dadd56be4ee8b0c718fe889b5d233b4fa6da726, which updated source/http.html to add response.status values to the create and delete history snippets and changed the note to mention required response.status before response.lastModified. The earlier supporting FHIR-19619 application, e8104dd10d3d5f75ab805718b09a981b57a738b4, removed older prose that implied response.status could be omitted.
additional_context: Current source/http.html says each history entry SHALL contain request and response elements, includes response.status in the create and delete snippets, and contains the approved response.status/lastModified note. Current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml requires response on history entries through bdl-3b and defines Bundle.entry.response.status as 1..1, matching the conformance rule even though the historical Jira text referred to bdl-4. FHIR-I minutes confirm the modified 16-0-0 approval. The description also suggested a history Bundle example on bundle-examples.html, but that was not included in the final modified resolution and the current RESTful API source is not misleading without adding a redundant example.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the current built source already satisfies the approved correction.
